title: Warehousing the American
author: David S. D’Amato
content:
Still from The Hole (El Hoyo). 2019. American prisons today are real-life
sites of body horror. In popular culture, body horror has roots in gothic
literature and centers our attention on the disturbing aspects of our
embodiedness or creatureliness. Discussing it within the context of what she
terms the Haunting Prison, Tea Fredriksson argues that […]
